display_long_description:
**This is an early access game**. It is still in development and may have bugs! It may increase the price once there is more content in it. Your feedback will help us make it better. Thank you!






[media]

Welcome to **Garden Haven**, a cozy Mixed Reality experience where your room becomes a lush garden ready to bloom. Transform everyday surfaces like tables, beds, and shelves into planting areas, creating a haven filled with vibrant flowers, fresh vegetables, and thriving greenery.


[media]

Step into your garden each day to nurture your plants: water, trim, and fertilize them with care. Alongside you is the gentle **Garden Spirit**, an adorable guide who teaches you the secrets of gardening. Feed her with what your garden produces: colorful blooms, juicy fruits, or seeds, and she will grow, evolving into a beautiful fairy who rewards your dedication.

[media]

But remember, a garden requires love and attention. Neglect it, and your plants will wither, leaving the Garden Spirit no choice but to say goodbye.

Garden Haven is a peaceful, family-friendly escape that blends learning, relaxation, and magic. It’s the perfect place to chill, grow, and discover the joy of bringing nature to life right in your own room.

**How will your garden grow?**
